title: Marriage in Christianity
content: Marriage in Christianity is a covenant between one man and one woman established by God. It reflects Christ's relationship with the Church and is built on love, faithfulness, and mutual commitment.

title: Forgiveness
content: Christians are called to forgive others as God forgave them in Christ. Forgiveness does not deny justice but releases bitterness and entrusts judgment to God.

title: Temptation and Sin
content: Temptation is common to all people, but God provides strength to endure it. Believers are called to resist sin and rely on the Holy Spirit for transformation and victory.

title: Anxiety and Fear
content: Scripture encourages believers to trust God in times of fear and anxiety. Prayer and reliance on God's promises bring peace that surpasses understanding.

title: Depression and Discouragement
content: The Bible acknowledges deep sorrow and discouragement but offers hope in God's presence and promises. Many biblical figures experienced despair yet found strength in God.
